row.evidence: CloudTalk's pricing table marks SSO ("Log in via your identity provider") as included only on Expert, and its help centre lists manual creation, the Add an Agent API and bulk upload as the ways to create users; no SCIM is documented.
row.notes: New row. Prices captured in EUR because the page loads EUR by default and USD only after a currency toggle that could not be rendered (renderer blocked on cloudtalk.io); numeric per-user fields left null for that reason. Annual per user/month: Lite €19 (€27 monthly), Starter €25 (€34), Essential €29 (€39), Expert €49 (€69, minimum 3 licences), plus custom quotes. Lite and Starter carry the same tagline and differ in bundled regional minutes; Lite is taken as the team plan. SSO (OIDC client ID/secret/discovery URL with Okta, Azure, OneLogin, Keycloak, plus Google) is Expert-only. No SCIM, JIT or IdP provisioning app; users are added manually, by bulk upload, or with the REST API's Add an agent endpoint (agent role only). REST API (Basic auth, 60 requests/min per company) requires Essential or higher, above the team plan.

okta.notes: Customer-created OIDC app per CloudTalk's guide; no OIN listing (okta.com/integrations/cloudtalk/ 404).

entra.notes: Azure SSO via app registration (OIDC); no Microsoft Learn tutorial (cloudtalk-tutorial 404).
